title: Sadak mo Yiɗde
intro: E jamaanu jarribooji diine, ruuhu noddaama e golle timmuɗe ngam ɗooftaade. Ummii e leydi ndi alaa ko woni e mum, ooɗoo limoore mawni haa wonti gooŋɗinal e muñal. Nde njiimaandi yamiri sadak, ɓe mbeltiima. Daartol maɓɓe ko kaaƴel gonngel e dewal.
clues: Ko miin woni jaabawol duwaawu annabi mawɗo mo ɓooyi ɗaminaade.
Min e yumma am min keddii e falnde hesere, min njogii tan ko date e ndiyam.
Mi mawni haa mi wonti annabi ganndiraaɗo goonga am e muñal am.
Mi walli baaba am ƴeftude tuugnorgal suudu ceniindu, halfinaandu Alla.
Nde baaba am haalani mi koyɗol ngam sakkitde mi, njaabtiimi, waɗ no yamiraa nii.
Alla teddinii ɗooftaare am nde neldi mi mbaroodi ummoraade e asamaan ngam soodde mi.
arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
